_comment: Baked-in calibration result: the judge ensemble Cascadia ships with. Normal operators consume this; they do not calibrate (calibration is admin/reviewer work — see PLAN.md §9 2026-06-01). The calibration TOOLING stays in-repo (it's the methodology differentiator); this file is the committed RESULT it justifies. Sensitive raw human labels are NOT committed — only the synthetic golden set + these derived findings.
panel_note: The live judge panel MUST be a different model family than the cascade tiers — the anti-self-preference filter (substring match on model name) discounts a judge scoring its own family. The default Anthropic Haiku->Sonnet cascade therefore uses an OpenAI panel. Add 'groq:llama-3.3-70b' or 'xai:grok-...' (with the corresponding key) to make it a true cross-PROVIDER panel rather than multi-model-single-provider. Consumed by scripts/quickstart.sh (CASCADIA_LIVE) and overridable via $CASCADIA_JUDGE_PANEL.

calibration_status.note: The 30-pair human pilot validated the harness + rubric (kappa improved v1->v2 from -0.02 to +0.52 after the rubric rewrite). The production-grade tau-b >= 0.7 gate is pending the ~200-pair Prolific run. These numbers are characterized, not aspirational; see docs/blog/methodology.md.
